citations.A1: Module-level cache never invalidated once set — fix by checking file mtime/hash on each call and reloading when it changes.
citations.A2: Tempting fix "reduce cache lifetime with a timer/TTL" masks the bug with polling latency instead of detecting actual changes — still serves stale data between TTL windows.
citations.A3: Tempting fix "just remove the cache and read the file every call" defeats the purpose of caching (perf) rather than addressing correctness — not a real fix, just an evasion.
citations.A4: Path parameter is ignored after first call (cache is keyed by nothing) — fix by keying the cache dict by resolved path
